STEP 1 - Scene: A airline-style tray meal: a serving of chicken curry (chunks in brown sauce) over white rice, plus a bowl of potato salad and a glass of water. The meal itself is the curry plate and potato salad bowl; the water glass is not food.

STEP 2 - Vessel: Main plate is a white oval/round paper plate, roughly 20 cm diameter (side-plate size), area ≈ 314 cm². Potato salad is in a small bowl, roughly 15 cm diameter, area ≈ 177 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Chicken curry pieces in brown sauce (main plate)
- White rice (main plate, partly visible under curry)
- Potato salad with mayonnaise dressing (bowl)

STEP 4 - Area (percent of the main plate, 314 cm²):
- Curry chicken and sauce: ~55% ≈ 173 cm², height ~1.5 cm → 259 ml × 0.95 ≈ 246 g
- White rice: ~15% ≈ 47 cm², height ~1.5 cm → 71 ml × 0.8 ≈ 57 g
- Potato salad (bowl, 177 cm² vessel, covers ~70% ≈ 124 cm²), height ~2.5 cm → 310 ml × 0.9 ≈ 279 g. Mayo-dressed potato salad is dense; a 0.9 density gives this, but the pile is shallow, so I use ~1.5 cm average → 186 ml × 0.9 ≈ 167 g.

STEP 5/6 - Grams (already computed above): curry ≈ 246 g, rice ≈ 57 g, potato salad ≈ 167 g.

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Chicken curry with sauce: ~120 kcal/100 g → 246 g ≈ 295 kcal
- Cooked white rice: ~130 kcal/100 g → 57 g ≈ 74 kcal
- Potato salad with mayonnaise: ~150 kcal/100 g → 167 g ≈ 251 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 470 g and ≈ 620 kcal. This is plausible for a generous airline curry-and-rice meal plus a side of potato salad. The curry chunks look moderately dense, so the estimate is reasonable.

Total: about 470 g, about 620 kcal.
